title: Patriots 53-man roster projection 1.0: Will New England really stick with 7 receivers?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: New England Patriots may carry seven wide receivers, including A.J. Brown and Kayshon Boutte.
The Patriots' roster projection includes three quarterbacks: Drake Maye, Tommy DeVito, and Behren Morton.
Patriots' projected offensive line features veterans and newcomers, including Alijah Vera-Tucker and first-round pick Caleb Lomu.

title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox from the Orioles, could debut against the Blue Jays this week.
Rutschman played two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester after recovering from wrist inflammation.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy states Rutschman's playing status depends on his condition after workouts.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Governor Maura Healey signed a bill allowing the state to seize Norwood Hospital through eminent domain.
The law enables transfer of the 11-acre Norwood site from Medical Properties Trust to a nonprofit for healthcare.
Norwood Hospital remains unfinished since 2020's flood damage; construction stalled after Steward Health Care's bankruptcy.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Springfield building collapse due to severe thunderstorm displaces 45 residents; no injuries reported.
Mayor Sarno declares state of emergency as storm causes outages and tree damage.
Red Cross and Eversource aid displaced residents and restore power after intense winds hit.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year career and four Super Bowl wins.
During his speech, Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick, referencing his girlfriend and his role at the University of North Carolina.
Vinatieri also humorously mentioned 'Deflategate', citing the Patriots' controversy following the 2014 AFC Championship Game win.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old bicyclist was struck and killed by a vehicle at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road, Williamstown.
The collision occurred at 5:40 p.m., and the child entered Main Street unintentionally, officials said.
No arrests or charges have been made, and the driver was not impaired by drugs or alcohol, per the DA's office.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials advise keeping pets away from Ames Pond after a dog died following a swim.
Possible algae bloom in Ames Pond is under investigation despite normal E. Coli levels in recent tests.
Cyanobacterial blooms can be harmful to humans and deadly to pets, prompting ongoing water safety monitoring.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: James Lamoureux, ex-NH State Trooper, was decertified after misleading police about GPS tracking his girlfriend.
Lamoureux pleaded guilty to false reports; his six-month prison sentence is suspended for two years.
He resigned, surrendered his law enforcement certification, and is banned from future police employment.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to reports of a man with a gun outside Grace Chapel; it was a misunderstanding.
The man was found polishing a musket-era powder horn while waiting to pick up his wife from work.
Police confirmed there was no threat, though the incident led to a heavy police response and road closures.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will make playoffs, despite their recent winning streak and current playoff position.
Red Sox won 32 of their last 38 games, now hold second A.L. wild-card spot with 64-52 record.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox 96% chance to reach playoffs; Parker insists they won't maintain performance.
